findings.F1: Half of the book's mean daily gain is the market's own rise. The book earns 0.0830 % a day; 0.0412 % of it is the position held times the coin's mean daily return, and 0.0418 % is timing. Holding the coins earns 0.0984 % a day at a Sharpe of 0.57, against the book's 1.17.
findings.F2: The timing comes from being out of the market in falling periods, not from catching rises.
findings.F3: The regime's share of time follows the window's outcome closely. Active share and the window's own return have a correlation of 0.61 over 141 coin-windows. By quartile of active share (4 %, 26 %, 59 %, 87 %), holding returns -21 %, +5 %, +42 % and +94 %, and the book -2 %, +5 %, +20 % and +53 %.
findings.F4: The year condition's forecast of the coming weeks is weak, so how much of F3 a trader could act on is unproven.
findings.F5: The 30-day return adds nothing to the 7-day move on its own.
findings.F6: The one sign of a 7-day effect beyond the year condition is a faded rebound in falling years. In a down year, a positive 30-day return is followed by a 7-day move 0.91 % below the coin's drift (t -1.80, 862 cases). In an up year it is followed by a move 0.62 % above it (t 1.18, 1038 cases).
findings.F7: The book's gain rests on a few long trades.

ideas.idea: A coin's own 1-year return predicts its move over the next 30 days: the higher its 1-year return, the more it rises over the next 30 days beyond its usual 30-day drift.
ideas.consequence: A long position in a coin is worth holding for a month in proportion to how much its past year has risen, and worth refusing or cutting as that year's return turns to a fall.
ideas.name: one-year trend sets the month

ideas.idea: In a year when a coin's own 1-year return is negative, a coin whose 30-day return is positive falls over the next 7 days below its usual 7-day drift, more as its 30-day rise is larger.
ideas.consequence: A month-long rebound inside a falling year is a reason to refuse a long trade, or to take a short one, for the following week.
ideas.name: rebounds fade in falling years
